contexts.text: The damnation (of hypocrites) is described by the prophetic words of David concerning Joab, when he had slain Abner by deceit (). Quoted and Explained.
As such were signified by Joab, therefore, by the command of Solomon, Joab was slain at the altar, whither he had fled ().

As truths and goods are dissolved and dissipated by evil deeds, it is said of Joab, when he had slain Abner by deceit, that he had given the bloods of war in his girdle which was on his loins; by which words is signified that he had dissipated and destroyed them.
